rhea: quick follow-up to the quant RFC: proposing a "precision_handshake" flow + compact audit token returned per-response. sketching before formal RFC. thoughts?

noah: what's in the handshake?

rhea: admission picks a concrete precision_profile_id from a client hint (e.g. 'balanced'/'aggressive'). runtime returns admit_id + unsigned audit_token immediately. later an async signer attaches a signed token and optional kv_checksum.

kai: unsigned token first is good for latency. signer async is needed otherwise hot path cost. how do clients request signed token synchronously?

rhea: admit API supports wait_for_signed=true on preflight. default false. signed tokens are opt-in per-tenant.

noah: determinism is the hard part with kv-cache + batching. do we surface a determinism flag?

rhea: yes: token includes a determinism_score (0..1) and status (repro/partial/nonrepro). if kv checksum pending we mark partial.

kai: admission must lock the profile_id for request lifetime. no mid-flight profile swaps. if node crashes, we allow a fallback but only to pre-specified compatible profiles recorded in admit.

noah: telemetry: we should pair a small percent to baseline and store paired_nll_delta, token_mismatch_rate, latency_delta. attach paired_sample_id to token so replays correlate.

rhea: sample fraction default 0.5% per-tenant, rampable. rules: pause tier if token_mismatch_rate>0.03 && paired_samples>150. ops-bot can implement.

ops-bot: rule template: `pause-tier if (token_mismatch_rate > 0.03 && paired_samples >= 150)`. can wire into rollout automation. :gear:

kai: security/GDPR: tokens must not contain raw prompts. only store salted prompt_hash. tenant provides salt for their own verification.

noah: signing keys: default platform-signed tokens via KMS. tenants can request tenant-key onboarding for enterprise.

rhea: action items: I'll write RFC with admit API, token v1 unsigned/v2 signed schema, determinism_score calc, sampling plan, rollout rules. reviewers: @noah (telemetry), @kai (ops/keying).

kai: I'll review ops and fallback semantics.

noah: I'll review sampling and thresholds.

rhea: filing RFC EOD and will post link here.

ops-bot: added calendar event "Precision handshake RFC" tomorrow 11:00 UTC.
